question: Where can I get a list of LNG terminals and underground gas storage facilities in Spain, with location, operator, capacity and status?

answer.summary: No single official dataset covers all 7 Spanish LNG terminals and 4 basic underground gas storage (UGS) facilities with coordinates, operator, capacity, and status. Officially, combine Enagas POI JSON endpoints (exact coordinates and capacities for 6/7 LNG and 3/4 UGS), Enagas ISG 2025 Excel (capacities for all 7 LNG), ACER REMIT (all 7 LNG operators), and BOE Order TED/1149/2026 (all 4 UGS and holders). Non-official GIE Excel databases cover all 7 LNG and 4 UGS capacities and status without coordinates; GEM GGIT adds LNG coordinates.
main_caveats: Enagas POI JSON omits non-Enagas Spanish assets (Mugardos LNG and Marismas UGS) while including 3 foreign terminals (Altamira MX, Revithoussa GR, Ravenna IT) with no country field.
GIE Storage DB row ES01V1 (35.93 TWh) is a virtual sum of the 4 physical Spanish UGS (summing all 5 rows double-counts); it also still lists Enagas/Gas Natural Fenosa for Marismas instead of Trinity.

El Musel LNG storage is reported as 130,000 m3 in Enagas ISG 2025 and GIE LNG DB vs 300,000 m3 physical (2x150,000 m3, with 170,000 m3 offered for logistics) on Enagas/Musel E-Hub pages; GIE LNG DB Sheet12 also contradicts itself on status.

Marismas capacity differs across sources (0.831 TWh / 831 GWh in GIE Storage DB vs 1,615 GWh approved max capacity on Trinity's site); BOE-A-2026-8574 dismantles old production wells, not Marismas UGS.
Underground storage commercial data in GIE AGSI+, Enagas ISG 2025 (p. 37), and Enagas storagetracing JSON is aggregated nationally (VGS / Almacenamiento unico) rather than per facility.
answer.confidence_reason: Checked MITECO, CNMC, BOE orders, Enagas GTS portal/Excel/POI JSONs, all 5 operators' websites, ACER REMIT, GIE databases/APIs, GEM GGIT, datos.gob.es, IDEE, CORES, and DERA Andalusia.

how_to_use.example_result: HTTP/2 200, content-length: 195288483, accept-ranges: bytes; CRS84 GeoJSON FeatureCollection with 4,802 global features (11 LNG terminal points in Spain).
steps: Request split Excel/GIS tables via the official download form on GEM's website (`download-data/`), or fetch the 195 MB map GeoJSON directly when bandwidth permits.
Filter features where `properties['all-countries']` contains `Spain` and `properties['tracker-display'] != 'Gas pipeline'`.
reading_traps: The map GeoJSON combines pipelines (large MultiLineStrings totaling 195 MB) with LNG terminals, and contains NO underground gas storage.
A facility can have multiple features per phase/unit (e.g. Mugardos has one `operating` row and one `cancelled` `Expansion` row).
Sagunto ownership in GEM (`Enagás SA [72.5%]`) reflects earlier stakes prior to Enagas reporting 92.5% ownership.

problems: Map GeoJSON exceeds 100 MB (195.3 MB; tested headers + Range); split Excel/CSV download requires submitting the web request form; includes 61 Spain pipeline features alongside 11 LNG terminal features.

evidence.claim: GEM GGIT interim map loads a 195 MB GeoJSON updated October 2026; split GIS/Excel files are available via the GEM download form.
GEM GGIT covers LNG import/export terminals and pipelines globally (no UGS).
evidence.quote: Gas pipeline and LNG terminal data are now provided as Excel files and in GeoJSON, GeoPackage, and shapefile formats via the download form.

sources.name: GIE — AGSI+ & ALSI Transparency Platforms (API)
sources.license: GIE Terms and Conditions of Use
sources.adds: Daily operational inventory, send-out/injection/withdrawal flows, contracted/available capacities, and EIC metadata via REST API; `/api/about` works without an API key.

coverage.geographic: Europe (Spain: 7 LNG terminals individually in ALSI; 1 aggregated virtual UGS in AGSI+)

inclusion_rule.value: Voluntary daily reporting by GIE member SSOs and LSOs under REMIT transparency platforms
inclusion_rule.quote: GIE’s AGSI and ALSI Transparency Platforms provide inventory reporting in daily resolution for underground gas storages and large-scale LNG terminals.

update_frequency.quote: Daily storage and LNG inventory status, unavailability reporting and urgent market messaging (UMM)

exclusions.value: No coordinates; AGSI+ aggregates all 4 Spanish physical UGS into a single virtual entity (`VGS Enagas Basic Underground Storage`, EIC `21W000000000032A`).
exclusions.quote: "name": "VGS Enagás Basic Underground Storage (Serrablo, Yela, Gaviota, Marismas)"

key_fields.meaning: Operator & facility EIC codes and names in `/api/about` and daily `/api` data
AGSI+ storage capacities and status (requires `x-key`)
ALSI LNG storage (`dtmi.lng`, `dtmi.gwh`), regasification, send-out, and status (requires `x-key`)

how_to_use.example_result: ALSI `/api/about` returns 5 Spanish LSOs (`BBG`, `Enagás Transporte`, `Musel E-Hub`, `Saggas`, `Reganosa`) and active/prior terminal EICs; `/api?country=ES` without `x-key` returns `{"error":"access denied","message":"Invalid or missing API key"}`.
steps: Query `https://agsi.gie.eu/api/about` and `https://alsi.gie.eu/api/about` without authentication to inspect Spanish operators, facility EICs, and transparency links.

For daily capacities, inventory, and status, register a free account on `https://agsi.gie.eu/` or `https://alsi.gie.eu/` and pass header `x-key: <API_KEY>` on `https://agsi.gie.eu/api?country=ES` and `https://alsi.gie.eu/api?country=ES`.
reading_traps: AGSI+ reports Spain ONLY as a single virtual storage group (`VGS Enagás Basic Underground Storage`), not by individual facility.

ALSI `/api/about` includes historical/expired facility entry `PRIOR_MUSEL_0001` (`operational_end_date: 2023-09-29`) alongside current `21W0000000000346`, and BBG's `publication_link` points to defunct `http://www.bahiasdebizkaia.com`.

problems: Daily capacity/inventory endpoints (/api?country=ES) require free registration and x-key header (tested without key: HTTP 200 with JSON access denied error); /api/about is public and tested.

evidence.claim: GIE API manual v013 documents free public REST API requiring mandatory registration for personal API key (`x-key`).
evidence.quote: Registration on the AGSI, ALSI or IIP website is mandatory for non-data providers to be able to use the API. Registration will result in a personal API key that is required within the API URL.

regulator.name: Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia (CNMC) — economic/access regulation and supervision; Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITECO) — energy planning, authorizations, and UGS remuneration

operators.note: 5 LNG terminal operators across 7 plants (Enagas Transporte S.A.U. for Barcelona, Cartagena, Huelva; Musel Energy Hub [Enagas 75%, Reganosa 25%]; Bahia de Bizkaia Gas S.L. [Enagas 50%]; Saggas [Enagas 92.5%]; Reganosa for Mugardos) and 2 regulated basic UGS operators (Enagas Transporte S.A.U. for Gaviota, Serrablo, Yela; Trinity Almacenamientos Andalucia S.A. for Marismas), technically coordinated by Enagas GTS.

publication_obligation.norm: Orden TED/181/2025 (NGTS 8.6), Ley 34/1998 del sector de hidrocarburos (arts. 59, 64, 65, 70), Real Decreto 949/2001, Circular 8/2019 CNMC, and Regulation (EC) No 715/2009
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Facility holders and the GTS must publish on their websites and SL-ATR operational, contracted, and available capacities for LNG unloading/storage/regasification/truck loading and UGS injection/withdrawal, plus GLE/GSE transparency templates and maintenance plans.
publication_obligation.frequency: Daily operational tracking and per capacity allocation cycle / annual system report

consolidated_republication.note: Enagas GTS republishes a consolidated technical capacity table for all 7 LNG plants in its annual report (Excel/PDF), while its map POI JSON omits Mugardos and Marismas and UGS operational/capacity reporting is largely aggregated into the single virtual storage model (Almacenamiento Unico / TVB).

checked_pages.saw: Annual Informe del Sistema Gasista Espanol 2025 (PDF and Excel): table on p. 28 gives technical capacities for all 7 LNG terminals without coordinates/operators; p. 37 gives only aggregated UGS totals.
HTML table of nominal regasification and truck-loading capacity (kWh/d) for 6 LNG plants (omits El Musel, typo in Sagunto 10.500.00); links to aggregated daily UGS tracking.

checked_pages.organization: Comision Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia (CNMC)
checked_pages.saw: IS/DE/002/26 PDF report on gas capacity allocation (gas year 2025): mentions all 7 LNG plants in truck-loading/unloading utilization charts and aggregated 35,926 GWh UGS capacity, no unified facility inventory.

checked_pages.organization: Ministerio para la Transicion Ecologica y el Reto Demografico (MITECO)
checked_pages.saw: Explains Ley 34/1998 Art. 59 basic gas network definitions (regasification plants and basic storage), with no consolidated facility dataset or register.

national_registry.note: Spain does not publish a unified official national registry of LNG terminals and underground gas storage facilities. MITECO's gas authorization page only links to CNMC's supplier (comercializadoras) census, and Art. 83 of Ley 34/1998 covers gas distributors rather than terminals/UGS. Authorizations appear individually in BOE and SABIA.

checked_pages.saw: Titled Autorizaciones Definitivas Gas Natural, but only contains a link to CNMC's list of gas natural suppliers (comercializadoras).
Energy registries overview page only lists radioactive material registries, no gas infrastructure registry.
Publishes supplier census and market/capacity supervision PDFs (IS/DE/002/26, IS/DE/005/26), no registry of LNG terminals or UGS.
Map and narrative cover only Enagas-participated facilities (6 LNG in Spain + 3 abroad; 3 UGS), excluding Mugardos and Marismas.
API keyword queries (gnl, regasificacion, gasoducto, gas natural) returned consumption, MIBGAS price, and regional pipeline metadata, no national LNG/UGS registry.

recipe: 1. Start from the structured official baseline: query Enagas POI JSONs (source 1) for coordinates and capacities of 6 LNG plants and 3 UGS, plus Enagas ISG 2025 Excel sheet `Pág. 28` (source 2) for all 7 LNG capacities and ACER REMIT JSON (source 4) for all 7 LNG operators.
2. Add Mugardos LNG location (`43.4613, -8.2395` from GEM GGIT or port of Ferrol/Mugardos in Reganosa docs) and confirm Mugardos specs from `https://mugardos.reganosa.com/terminal-de-gnl/`.

3. Retrieve the latest annual BOE remuneration order (currently `BOE-A-2026-22792`) Annex II to confirm all 4 regulated basic UGS facilities and their current legal holders (`Enagas Transporte, SAU` and `Trinity Almacenamientos Andalucía, SA`).

4. Query BOE (`https://www.boe.es/buscar/`) for the missing UGS (`Marismas`) and non-operational UGS (`Castor`) to obtain municipality (`Almonte, Huelva` in `BOE-B-2025-7171`), distinguish hydrocarbon production dismantling (`BOE-A-2026-8574`) from active UGS, and confirm Castor decommissioning (`BOE-A-2025-7577`).
5. Pull Marismas approved maximum capacity (`1,615 GWh`) from Trinity's page metadata (cross-checking against `0.831 TWh` working gas in GIE Storage Database).
if_unstructured.location_method: Exact WGS84 coordinates for 6/7 LNG terminals and 3/4 UGS come directly from Enagas POI JSON (source 1); Mugardos LNG coordinates come from GEM GGIT (source 8) verified against PNOA orthophotos / port of Ferrol. For Marismas UGS (no public coordinate layer), locate the municipality (Almonte, Huelva) from BOE-B-2025-7171 and inspect MITECO SABIA environmental project annexes or PNOA orthophotos/Cadastre around Marismas-3 / Rincon-1 wellpads.
cross_with: Cross-check Enagas ISG 2025 `Pág. 28` against GIE LNG Database and operator pages to reconcile El Musel storage (130,000 m3 operational vs 300,000 m3 physical) and Barcelona storage (760,000 vs 680,000 m3).

Cross-check BOE annual UGS remuneration orders against GIE Storage Database to catch outdated operator names (Trinity vs Enagas/Gas Natural Fenosa for Marismas) and exclude virtual aggregate `ES01V1`.

where_published.name: Boletín Oficial del Estado (BOE)
where_published.what: Annual UGS remuneration orders (listing regulated basic UGS and holders), administrative authorizations, public consultations (e.g. well drilling), and decommissioning resolutions (e.g. Castor).
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Full-text search at https://www.boe.es/buscar/ under 'Todo el BOE' or 'Legislación' using exact phrases such as "almacenamiento subterráneo" plus facility name ("Marismas", "Serrablo", "Gaviota", "Yela", "Castor") or "planta de regasificación".

example_document.what_it_gives: Public consultation notice (28/02/2025) stating: "La empresa Trinity Almacenamientos Andalucía, S.A. (en adelante TAA), único titular y operador del almacenamiento subterráneo de gas natural «Marismas»... en el término municipal de Almonte en la Provincia de Huelva", confirming operational status ("en fase de explotación como almacenamiento regulado del sistema gasista") and project Marismas-3NE next to existing Marismas-3.

where_published.name: MITECO SABIA — Buscador de Evaluación Ambiental
where_published.what: Environmental impact assessment (EIA) files for state-competence energy infrastructure (authorizations, modifications, decommissioning), including project memories and location annexes.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Filter by 'Título' (e.g. "Marismas", "Castor", "regasificación"), province, procedure status ('RESOLUCION EMITIDA', 'TERMINADO'), and project type ('EXPLORACIÓN Y EXPLOTACIÓN HIDROCARBUROS' or pipelines).

example_document.what_it_gives: BOE publication of MITECO DGPEM resolution (01/04/2025) authorizing Phase 1 decommissioning of Castor UGS ("Sellado y abandono definitivo de los pozos de 'Castor'"), summarizing prior RDL 13/2014 concession extinction and EIA clearance.

where_published.name: Trinity Energy Storage — Marismas UGS facility page
where_published.what: Facility description for the only non-Enagas basic UGS in Spain (Marismas), supplying approved maximum operating capacity and reservoir names.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Navigate to 'Infraestructuras de almacenamiento' -> 'Marismas'; if fetching statically with curl, inspect `<meta name="description">` to avoid unhydrated JS counter placeholders.

example_document.what_it_gives: Meta description: "Marismas is a natural gas underground storage facility in Huelva operated by Trinity Energy Storage since 2012 with an approved maximum operating capacity of 1,615 GWh." Body text: "It consists of two depleted gas fields, Marismas-3 and Rincón, and is integrated into the Spanish gas system."

related_not_answering.name: Enagas GTS — Seguimiento en almacenamientos subterráneos (storagetracing JSON)
related_not_answering.why: Publishes only aggregated national daily injection/extraction forecasts (no per-facility list, location, operator, or status).

related_not_answering.name: Enagas GTS — Capacidades técnicas y flujos físicos (HTML table)
related_not_answering.why: Incomplete summary HTML table of regasification and truck-loading capacity (kWh/d) for only 6 LNG terminals (omits El Musel, has typo 10.500.00 in Sagunto, and omits storage volume, UGS, coordinates, operator, and status).

related_not_answering.name: DERA Andalucía — Capa 10_15_PlantaGas (GPKG)
related_not_answering.why: Regional Andalusia dataset only: contains 1 LNG point (Regasificacion de Huelva, 5 tanks, 619,500 m3) and omits Marismas UGS and the rest of Spain.

related_not_answering.name: CORES — Estadísticas de Gas Natural (importaciones-gas-punto-entrada.xlsx & existencias-gas.xlsx)
related_not_answering.why: Monthly import volumes by entry point (6 LNG plants, omits El Musel) and aggregated national stocks; no capacities, coordinates, operators, or per-UGS breakdown.

related_not_answering.name: CNMC — Informe de supervisión de asignación de capacidad (IS/DE/002/26) & CNMC Data
related_not_answering.why: Supervises capacity auctions/utilization percentages and market volumes rather than publishing a facility inventory with locations, technical capacities, and statuses.

related_not_answering.name: MITECO — Autorizaciones Definitivas Gas Natural
related_not_answering.why: Despite its title, it only links to CNMC's list of commercial suppliers (comercializadoras), not infrastructure facilities.

open_questions: What are the exact coordinates of the Marismas underground gas storage surface facilities (Marismas-3 and Rincon-1 wellpads in Almonte, Huelva), and why do GIE Storage Database (0.831 TWh = 831 GWh) and Trinity Energy Storage (1,615 GWh approved maximum operating capacity) report different capacity figures?

history.note: First-pass research: combined official Enagas POI JSONs, ISG 2025 Excel, ACER REMIT, BOE orders, and GIE/GEM non-official databases; Marismas UGS lacks public coordinates.
